evidence: All 6 acceptance-criteria tests pass in tank_data (22 tests total, 0 failures): test_provenance_schema_roundtrip, test_provenance_optional_fields, test_confidence_levels_enum, test_valid_range_enforcement, test_backward_compatible_loading, test_provenance_display.

11 provenance unit tests pass in tank_core covering ConfidenceLevel roundtrip/rejection, ParamMeta display (full/empty/notes), range check (in-range, out-of-range, no-range, non-finite value, invalid range), and format_param (with and without notes).

Provenance schema fully implemented: ConfidenceLevel enum (Literature/Expert/Heuristic/Placeholder) with serde lowercase, ParamMeta struct with deny_unknown_fields and all 5 optional fields (unit, source, confidence, valid_range, notes), RangeWarning struct with context-aware Display.

Per-parameter metadata (BTreeMap<String, ParamMeta>) now present on ProcessParamsPreset, SourceWaterPreset, AND ShrimpPreset — all three with param_value(), format_param(), check_ranges() methods via the ParamMetaPreset trait.

Range diagnostics wired into all three production loaders: load_process_params(), load_source_water(), and load_shrimp() all route through load_validated_with_range_diagnostics() which calls check_ranges() and emits warnings via eprintln(). Structured APIs (load_*_with_diagnostics) also available.

DIC rate fields (respiration_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour, photosynthesis_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour) confirmed present in ProcessParamsPreset::validate() non-negative/finite array, with dedicated test process_preset_rejects_invalid_dic_rates.
Legacy _mg/_mg_total valid_range contract documented in ParamMeta.valid_range doc comment (provenance.rs:54-60): bounds must be in normalized concentration units matching the unit field.
preserve_non_finite_division() correctly retains NaN/Infinity for diagnostic paths while normalizing finite values.
ProcessParamsPreset::validate() rejects unknown param_meta keys. ParamMeta uses deny_unknown_fields. Both guard against typos in metadata.
Backward compatibility confirmed: shipped TOML presets without param_meta load successfully (test_backward_compatible_loading + shipped_param_meta_loaders_return_no_diagnostics).
Validation integration test step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error passes (11/11 validation tests green).
clippy -D warnings passes clean on tank_data and tank_core (the crates modified by this bead). tank_scenarios has a pre-existing clippy issue from tanksim-6e5.4.3-v2, unrelated to this work.
tank_scenarios lib tests pass (4/4), confirming scenario materialization compiles and loads through the updated preset APIs.
Budget tracking (24 tests), budget helpers (13 tests), and shrimp population (16 tests) integration suites all pass, confirming no regressions from the provenance changes.
findings_or_gaps: No shipped TOML data files currently contain [param_meta.*] sections. The infrastructure is ready but actual metadata enrichment is deferred to downstream bead tanksim-6e5.7.2. This is by design — the current bead's scope is schema and loader support.

Preset-level Provenance.confidence remains Option<String> rather than Option<ConfidenceLevel>. This is documented as intentional (presets.rs doc comment) since preset-level confidence serves a different granularity than per-parameter confidence. Covered by test_preset_level_provenance_confidence_is_freeform.

PlantPreset, SubstratePreset, and ScenarioPreset still lack per-parameter param_meta support (only file-level provenance). These are lower-priority preset families and can be extended later if needed, but this is a known coverage gap.
Pre-existing clippy failure in tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:755 (redundant field name `kind: kind`) from bead tanksim-6e5.4.3-v2 — not introduced by this work, but will need cleanup separately.
